message: I'm looking to buy a T75 Row-Crop with delivery and setup, ready to buy today. My budget is $62,000 total. Can you do that?

Thanks for coming in ready to buy. The T75 Row-Crop has 75 hp, an enclosed cab with A/C, and 4WD, and delivery and setup includes on-site delivery within 150 miles plus a full walkthrough. Together those list at $68,900. I can't get down to $62,000, but I can do $66,000 for the tractor delivered and set up, and we can finalize it today.
Heartland Tractor posts the T75 at $65,950 with delivery at $875. I'd prefer to buy from you online today, but I need a sharper number. $63,500 delivered and set up and I'll check out right now.

I appreciate that you'd like to buy from us today. I can't confirm Heartland's pricing, but I want to earn your business. I'll meet you partway: $64,750 for the T75 Row-Crop, delivered within 150 miles, set up, with an on-site walkthrough. That's $4,150 under list, and you can check out right now.
Close. Make it $64,000 even, delivered and set up, and we have a deal right now.
Deal. $64,000 even for the T75 Row-Crop with delivery within 150 miles, setup, and an on-site walkthrough. Your offer id will be issued now so you can check out.
